info.title: Restarters API
info.description: An API for accessing Restarters data.  No API authorisation is necessary - all data is read-only and public.

patch.description: Edits an event.  The event of a group cannot be changed after creation.  Only the fields sent are changed; a field sent empty or null is cleared.

parameters.name: includeNextEvent
parameters.description: Include the next event for the group.  This makes the call slower.  Default false.

parameters.description: Include the counts of hosts and restarters.  This makes the call slower.  Default false.

parameters.name: includeNextEvent
parameters.description: Include the next event for the group.  This makes the call slower.  Default false.

parameters.name: includeDetails
parameters.description: Include the details for each group.  This makes the call significantly slower.  Default false.

parameters.name: includeStats
parameters.description: Include the stats for each group.  This makes the call significantly slower.  Default false.

parameters.name: updated_start
parameters.description: The minimum start date for when a group was updated in ISO8601 format.  Useful if you need to only process groups that have had recent changes.  Inclusive.

parameters.name: updated_end
parameters.description: The maximum end date for when a group was updated in ISO8601 format.  Inclusive.

parameters.name: group_tag
parameters.description: Filter by group tag ID. Only groups with this tag will be returned.

get.description: Returns list of tags available for a network. Administrators see global + network tags; others see only network-specific tags.

parameters.name: network_only
parameters.description: Only return tags specific to this network (exclude global tags)

post.description: Create a new tag for a network. Requires authentication as a Network Coordinator for this network or an Administrator.

403.description: Forbidden - User is not a coordinator for this network

422.description: Validation error - tag name already exists in this network

get.description: Returns impact statistics for a network, optionally filtered by group tag.

parameters.description: Filter stats to only include groups with this tag ID

put.description: Update a tag for a network. Requires authentication as a Network Coordinator for this network or an Administrator.

403.description: Forbidden - User is not a coordinator for this network

422.description: Validation error or duplicate tag name

delete.description: Delete a tag from a network. Requires authentication as a Network Coordinator for this network or an Administrator. This will remove the tag from all groups.

403.description: Forbidden - User is not a coordinator for this network or tag is global

get.summary: Export repair records in Open Repair Data Standard v0.3
get.description: Bulk export of repair records for the Open Repair Alliance. Covers approved events on approved groups only. Returns JSON by default, or CSV when format=csv. Administrator role required.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: A valid user API token. The caller must hold the Administrator role.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only records whose device, event or group row changed at or after this time

parameters.name: event_start
parameters.description: Only records from events starting at or after this date

parameters.name: event_end
parameters.description: Only records from events starting at or before this date

parameters.name: powered
parameters.description: Restrict to powered or unpowered categories. Unfiltered when absent.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated user is not an Administrator

503.description: Export is not configured: no id namespace or data provider name has been set

OrdsRepair.title: OrdsRepair
OrdsRepair.description: A repair record in Open Repair Data Standard v0.3. Columns and their order follow the standard; every missing value is null in JSON and an empty string in CSV.

id.description: Stable identifier the consumer upserts on, namespaced by the instance's assigned prefix.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country of the event's group.

repair_barrier_if_end_of_life.description: Only set when repair_status is End of life.

group_identifier.description: Name of the group that ran the event.

problem.description: Volunteer-written description of the fault, with contact details and identifiers redacted. Personal names are not pattern-detectable and are not removed. Empty unless the instance sets ORDS_INCLUDE_PROBLEM, and redacted unless it also sets ORDS_SCRUB_PROBLEM=false.
